lead.zh: 先读十个常用概念，再做三道自测。目标是分清模型、产品与能力边界，不需要记住全部名词。
lead.en: Read ten common concepts, then try three questions. Aim to distinguish models, products and limits without memorizing the whole glossary.

steps: 大模型 - 大语言模型
AI 产品 vs AI 模型
AI Agent 与聊天机器人的区别

zh: 向外行解释：大模型是怎么「学会」的，为什么按 Token 计费
说清「AI 产品」和「AI 模型」的区别，各举一个例子
说出大模型至少一件明确做不到的事
en: Explain to a newcomer how a large model learned, and why billing counts tokens
Tell apart an AI product from an AI model, with one example each
Name at least one thing a large model plainly cannot do

answers.zh: 训练用样本调整模型参数，推理时依据输入生成输出。Token 是处理文本的单位；服务商通常分别统计输入与输出的用量，具体收费规则看产品说明。
answers.en: Training adjusts model parameters from examples; inference generates output from an input. Tokens are text-processing units. Providers commonly count input and output usage separately; the product defines billing.

answers.zh: 模型是生成或处理内容的核心；产品还包括界面、检索、存储和权限。例如，一个聊天网站是产品，它接入的语言模型是其中一个部件。
answers.en: A model generates or processes content. A product also has an interface, retrieval, storage and permissions. A chat website is a product; its language model is one component.
answers.review: AI 产品 vs AI 模型

answers.zh: 没有可靠资料或相应工具时，模型不能保证给出最新事实，也不能仅凭流畅的回答证明内容正确。可举一个需要核对原始出处的例子。
answers.en: Without reliable sources or suitable tools, a model cannot guarantee current facts. Fluent wording does not prove correctness. Give one example that needs an original-source check.

nextTask.zh: 试着写一份有资料、有边界的提示
nextTask.en: Try writing a source-grounded, scoped prompt
